title: Immunofluorescence for Free-Floating Brain Sections
author: Jill R. Crittenden
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kracv2e
materials: ProLong™ Gold Antifade Mountant with DAPI

Brains are dissected from deeply-anesthetized mice that were trans-cardially perfused with 10 ml of room-temperature 0.9% saline followed by 60 ml of 4% PFA. PFA must be used with appropriate protection and ventilation. Brains are then post-fixed in 4% PFA in glass vials for 2 hours with gentle rocking at 4 °C. Replace PFA solution with glycerol cryoprotectant solution until the brain sinks (overnight), at 4 °C. Store the brains in the same solution at 4 °C until sectioning. For sectioning, remove the brains from storage cryoprotectant solution, freeze in powdered dry ice on a chuck, and cut at 30 μm intervals on a sliding microtome. Put sequential sections into adjacent wells of a multi-well plastic tray containing 0.1% sodium azide in 0.1 M PB for storage at 4 °C until immunostaining. Paraformaldehyde (PFA) is toxic, a strong irritant, and flammable as a solid. steps.title: Rinse sections in PBST
steps.instruction: Wash the free‑floating brain sections in PBST three times, each wash lasting 2 minutes.

steps.title: Block sections
steps.instruction: Incubate the sections in blocking solution for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Rinse sections in PBST
steps.instruction: Rinse the blocked sections in PBST three times, each rinse lasting 2 minutes.

steps.title: Rinse sections in 0.1 M PB
steps.instruction: Rinse the sections in 0.1 M phosphate buffer three times, each rinse lasting 2 minutes.

steps.title: Mount sections onto slides
steps.instruction: Submerge the sections in mounting solution in a large glass Petri dish and transfer them onto glass microslides using a paintbrush.

substeps.instruction: Place sections in mounting solution within a large glass Petri dish.
Using a paintbrush, move each section onto a glass microslide (VWR #48311-703).

steps.title: Dry mounted sections
steps.instruction: Let the slides sit flat, loosely covered with foil, until they appear almost dry (15–60 minutes, depending on room humidity).

steps.title: Store slides
steps.instruction: Store the slides in the dark at 4 °C.
